sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: 'Quality Checks' row 26 (#25 judge_prompts_drive_the_browser) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 26 (no internal annotation in E+ columns for this row); 'Deterministic Checks' C28 (prompt opens localhost URL) for context
model-beraking-prompts/handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md (lesson 13: row 25 flag for public internet address)
evidence: All five dimension prompts open the live app and name the browser tool on line 1: gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1 'Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP.'; scored/visual/prompt.md:1-2 'Evaluate the rendered application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP.' Every judge.toml wires [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright' command='playwright-mcp' --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium (render/constraints/polish/visual lines 11-15, functional 17-21, plus the verifier restart server functional:24-28); tests/Dockerfile:19,33-38 installs @playwright/mcp@0.0.79 and links chromium. Evidence is restricted to the live app: render:2 'Use only rendered browser behavior'; constraints:2 'browser-visible behavior and browser network evidence only'; polish:4 'Judge the rendered product and interactions, not code style' and :22 'from browser-visible evidence'; visual:41 'from rendered evidence'; functional:23-28 'passes only on evidence you gathered in this session ... A step you skipped, replaced with a different test, or could not perform fails', :38-39 'replays are in-page calls from the app's origin. Never use curl or shell commands', :46 'Never ... run shell or install commands'. All prompts treat 'source' as untrusted evidence. Anti-first-paint: functional:11-19, polish:10-18, visual:18-26 global gate 'static mock, static shell, missing backend, or seeded-looking facade fails ... a first-paint imitation does not pass'; render gate criterion requires a wrong password to be refused and Gwen's real sign-in (render/judge.toml:26-34); constraints gate requires sign-in then reload (constraints/judge.toml:26-33). Every one of the 28 criteria (1+1+17+5+4) is an interactive browser procedure (sign-ins, posts, recorded-request replays, multi-context live updates, restart_app then fresh page, viewport 390x844 / 1440x900, scrollWidth eval, rendered likert anchors); none can be answered from source or memory. Prompts forbid guessing routes (functional:34-36, app_context:25) so a conforming app with different endpoints is not penalised. app_context.md:26 'Every address is on http://localhost:3000. No criterion needs any address outside this machine except as plain text typed into a message' (addresses Colderwater lesson 13). {app_context} is substituted by test.sh:197-201 (identical to template). Prompt structure matches the template prompts (rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/*/*/prompt.md line 1 identical); judge isolated=false is template-controlled. Note (not a defect): functional safe_formatting (functional/judge.toml:164-165) posts 'https://example.org/lease' as message text and asks that it be a link opening in a new tab; that is verifiable from the rendered anchor/new-tab behaviour without depending on example.org content, and network is public by delivery profile, so it is not a public-address grading dependency. Runtime: raw-evidence-index scope says 'Full configured grading/workload ... are absent'; the scripted golden harness is Playwright but not the LLM judge, so whether the judge actually drove the browser in a configured run is NOT EXERCISED; this row's skill procedure (quality-checks.md:109) is a prompt-source check and is satisfied. Counterexample attempts: (a) static first-paint mock with seeded-looking data fails the render gate (wrong-password refusal, real sign-in) and the scored global gates; (b) conforming app with different routes/labels is protected by 'match controls by intent and label', 'any endpoint path, payload shape or cookie name is acceptable' (functional:54).
